GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up early part of home straight. Nearing the 350m made contact when endeavouring to improve into a narrow run. Near the 100m became unbalanced & was inclined to hang in after being contacted on the hindquarters. When questioned re settling behind midfield, rdr std no specific instructions issued, & after being slow to begin he was reluctant to ride mnt forward to avoid it overracing, so for this reason he allowed inside rnrs to improve, which resulted in him settling further back than anticipated. Tnr said his preference is for gelding to be ridden more prominently next start.
